exit 0
--- stdout
Recover a crashed agent by performing full cleanup:
- Release task claims (executing → initial for doers, reviewing → submitted for reviewers)
- Remove git worktree and branch (doers only)
- Delete agent from state
Idempotent: safe to run multiple times (no error if agent already gone).
By default, refuses to recover agents whose PID is still alive.
Usage:
liza recover-agent <agent-id> [flags]
Flags:
--cli string respawn the agent after cleanup using this CLI (e.g., claude, codex)
--expected-transition string current task transition_id captured before the request; requires --request-id
--force override PID liveness check (refuse by default if process is alive)
-h, --help help for recover-agent
--json output result as structured JSON
--reason string reason for recovering the agent (default "agent recovery")
--request-id string logical request ID; preserve with its original --expected-transition across retries
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
